metadata.title: Noteim
metadata.description: Meeting minutes from voice recordings, built for Vietnamese professionals.

app.redirecting: Taking you to the style guide

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Every Noteim design token: palette A (Sen and Dien), type, spacing, radii, shadows and motion. Toggle light and dark with the button at the top.
styleguide.themeHint: Your choice is stored on this device and survives a page reload.
styleguide.colorsBaseHint: The light background is a cool porcelain white, not cream. The dark background is deep indigo, not black.
styleguide.colorsActionConvention: Sen (pink) is what the user does, dien (violet) is what the AI does. Color alone tells you which content was written by the machine.
styleguide.dawnHint: Only for the record button, the glow behind the voice ribbon while recording, and the logo. Never as a background or for heading text.
styleguide.tagsHint: Every tag always comes with an icon and text, never color alone. In dark theme the tag background is its text color at 16% opacity.
styleguide.speakersHint: Six colors, assigned in order of appearance. From the seventh speaker they cycle again with a hatched pattern. Only for the voice ribbon, the dot before a name, and the left bar of a transcript line, never as text color.
styleguide.speaker: Speaker {index}

tokenSurface2.name: Recessed
tokenSurface2.usage: Recessed areas, chip background, selected row

tokenDien.name: Dien (electric violet)
tokenDien.usage: Everything AI-made: answers, suggestions, Ask AI button

styleguide.typographyHint: Headings and large numbers use Bricolage Grotesque, everything else uses Be Vietnam Pro. Line height never goes below 1.3x so Vietnamese diacritics have room.
styleguide.typographyDesktopNote: Desktop: display 44/52, h1 30/38, the rest unchanged.
styleguide.testString: Đặng Thị Quỳnh Ngữ, Nguyễn Hữu Phước: thỏa thuận chuyển nhượng 12,5 tỷ
styleguide.spacingHint: Multiples of 4. Values below are in pixels.
styleguide.radiusHint: Radii follow a hierarchy, never one value for everything.

radiusBlock.name: block — 16 px
radiusBlock.usage: AI content blocks, images, quote cards

styleguide.shadowHint: Prefer layering with background color and hairlines. Shadows are tinted indigo, never gray. Dark theme uses no shadows, only borders.
styleguide.shadowDarkNote: In dark theme both shadows are off and replaced by borders.
styleguide.motionHint: Motion only ever answers one interaction: press, open, close, drag.
